name: GTZAN Genre Collection
description: A collection of 1,000 30-second audio excerpts across 10 music genres, widely used as a music-genre classification benchmark. GTZAN is a legacy baseline with known flaws, including mislabeled and duplicated recordings and artist-related data leakage; results should be interpreted with those limitations in mind.
citation: Tzanetakis, G., & Cook, P. (2002). Musical genre classification of audio signals. IEEE Transactions on Speech and Audio Processing, 10(5), 293–302. https://doi.org/10.1109/TSA.2002.800560
